places.name: Adobe Walls
places.note: Sheltering from rain in the deserted, snake-ridden ruins, Augustus plays cards for buttons with Lorena, who finally speaks again.
places.location_hint: on the Canadian River in the Texas Panhandle

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: Swollen by rain, it holds up four trail herds; after they cross, Augustus and Lorena ford it, and later bathe there.

places.name: Trail herds' crossing on the Canadian
places.note: Four herds wait for the river to drop; Wilbarger brings food, whiskey and a tent to Augustus's camp nearby, then crosses in the morning.
places.location_hint: on the Canadian River, an afternoon's ride east (downriver) of Adobe Walls, Texas Panhandle/Indian Territory border area

places.raw_name: a ridge north of the river
places.name: Augustus and Lorena's ridge camp
places.note: They pitch the borrowed tent and pass a rainy week here waiting for Call's herd while Lorena slowly recovers.
places.location_hint: on a long ridge about two miles north of the Canadian River, just beyond the herds' crossing east of Adobe Walls

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus treats Lorena just as he used to there.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Texas
places.note: Augustus tells Lorena eating well will make her its prettiest woman again.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Augustus promises she'll get there yet; she barely recalls it as Jake's promised cool city of boats.

places.name: Yale College
places.note: Augustus recognizes Wilbarger as the Yale man who read the Latin on his sign.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Wilbarger's foreman died south of it; he advises taking frail Lorena back there for care.

places.name: Purgatoire River
places.note: Augustus believes Blue Duck is bound there.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Wilbarger will have business there later and asks for the tent to be sent there.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Augustus says he has unfinished business there.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Wilbarger asks after the young sheriff from there; Augustus reports his crew was killed.

places.name: July's canyon-mouth camp on the Canadian
places.note: Augustus tells Wilbarger they buried July's three companions west of here.
places.location_hint: canyon mouth on the Canadian River, Texas Panhandle, west of Adobe Walls

groups.label: Augustus and Lorena
groups.hint: tent on a ridge two miles north of the Canadian, waiting for Call's herd

groups.label: Wilbarger's outfit
groups.hint: crossed the Canadian and moved north out of sight

groups.label: July Johnson
groups.hint: reported heading north from the Canadian four days earlier
